subject: ours:systematic-debugging
why: The restart heuristic (persisted-state-suspect, delivered by 2026-11-01-cursor_plugins-pstack-principles:217) moves from references/localization.md into the skill's diagnosis entry, step 2, before a probe is chosen. The reference loads only for cross-layer tracing or bisection, so a restart-only failure in one known component never reached it, and loading it later could not make persisted state the first suspect. The heuristic now has one owner, the skill body; references/localization.md no longer states it. The trait list is unchanged.

subject: ours:mvp-mode

It now lists no-onward-delegation too, and its trait-sharing entry names mvp-mode with delegation and doc:AGENTS.md, giving the router copy's audience: plugin users who skip the optional AGENTS.md. subject: cursor_plugins:skill:pstack/skills/principle-build-the-lever#tool-over-hand-work
why: Owner ruling R10 revised (2026-11-01, critic 1b-build finding 1): reuse existing deterministic tools and checks; build a rerunnable tool only when it saves repeated work or supplies proof a reviewer needs. The line no longer delivers tool-over-hand-work whole (T5), so it adopts into the variant tool-when-it-pays.
modification: Narrower than upstream: existing deterministic tools and checks come first, and a new rerunnable tool is built only when it materially reduces repeated work or supplies proof a reviewer needs, keeping its output.

subject: cursor_plugins:skill:pstack/skills/principle-guard-the-context-window#bulk-to-subagents
why: Owner ruling R15 revised (2026-11-01, critic 1b-build finding 4): the router hands independent work to a subagent, a narrower mechanism, so it adopts into the variant delegate-independent-by-default.
